recommendation: Keep the commit. It completes the final FHIR-32447 model decision in active core source and aligns examples with later outcome terminology; any broader AuditEvent terminology review should be handled as a separate issue.
issue_request: FHIR-32447 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 after questioning why AuditEvent.outcome used an extensible outcome binding. The accepted resolution replaced the former outcome CodeableConcept with an outcome backbone containing code 1..1 code required-bound to the AuditEvent outcome value set and detail 0..* CodeableConcept with an example binding.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-32447-tagged commit was found. Commit a4a8e4475f implicitly added the AuditEvent.outcome backbone while applying nearby AuditEvent issues, but it retained the older outcome binding path; commit d7fdf7acfe then changed that binding from extensible to preferred. Current R5/current source therefore had the backbone shape but still missed FHIR-32447's primitive code datatype and required binding, and retained stale outcome.text/details.text prose.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps auditevent=AuditEvent, placing the edited StructureDefinition, value set, examples, and checked-in SVG in build scope. FHIR-32445 and FHIR-39622 later moved the AuditEvent outcome value set away from DICOM numeric codes to issue-severity with success included, so the examples needed success/error primitive codes once the required binding was restored. Security block-vote Confluence/Zulip evidence lists FHIR-32447 in the approved September 2021 AuditEvent block and no conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published commit dd76d3cd95aebc156fdb33db86924996862b89e9 changes AuditEvent.outcome.code from Coding/preferred to code/required, removes stale DICOM/example metadata from the outcome binding/value set, corrects outcome/detail text, updates all AuditEvent outcome examples to primitive success/error codes, and updates the AuditEvent SVG to match the authoritative StructureDefinition.
source_changes: source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml: changed AuditEvent.outcome.code to primitive code with required binding, removed stale DICOM binding metadata, and corrected outcome/detail prose.
source/auditevent/valueset-audit-event-outcome.xml: renamed the value set metadata from example outcome back to Audit Event Outcome to match the required binding.
source/auditevent/*example*.xml: converted populated AuditEvent outcome.code examples from old DICOM numeric Coding blocks to primitive success/error codes.
source/auditevent/auditevent.svg: synchronized displayed outcome datatype, binding strength, outcome/detail tooltip, and detail value set link with the source definition.
